# Tynker

> > Tynker is a comprehensive coding education platform for kids offering Python, JavaScript, Minecraft modding, and AI-powered games with curricula for home learners and K-12 schools.

Tynker provides visual and text-based coding courses, Minecraft customization tools (skins, mods, blocks, items, add-ons), and structured STEAM curriculum aligned with educational standards. The platform serves both individual learners and educational institutions with age-appropriate lessons and community-driven content.

## Key Topics

- Coding for Kids
- Minecraft Modding
- Python
- JavaScript
- AI & Game Design

- Minecraft Skins

## Getting Started

- [Coding For Kids, Kids Online Coding Classes & Games | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com): Tynker's platform for coding education with Python, JavaScript, Minecraft modding
- [Hour of Code | Coding Puzzles, AI and Games | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com/hour-of-code): Hour of Code activities with AI games and coding puzzles for learners
- [A Parents Guide on Coding | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com/parents): Parent guide to Tynker's coding courses and curriculum overview

## Minecraft Customization Hub

- [Minecraft - Ultimate Resource for Minecraft | Tynker | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com/minecraft): Minecraft mods, skins, texture packs creation and deployment hub
- [Minecraft Skins - Checkout Largest Collections of MC Skins | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com/minecraft/skins): Minecraft skin editor and collection with customization tools
- [List of Best Minecraft Mods 2024 - Minecraft Modpacks | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com/minecraft/mods): Minecraft mods creation, customization and deployment platform
- [Minecraft Add-Ons | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com/minecraft/addons): Minecraft add-ons editor and community-created mods library
- [Minecraft Mobs - Find Popular and All New Mobs List | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com/minecraft/mobs): Minecraft mob editor and library for custom mob creation
- [Minecraft Blocks - All Minecraft Blocks List | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com/minecraft/blocks): Minecraft block editor for custom block creation and deployment
- [Minecraft Items | Tynker](https://www.tynker.com/minecraft/items): Minecraft item editor for custom weapons, armor and tools
